$comment: Wish list for Anti-AI Design written before we chose to fork. It is NOT the contract: the fork's real contract is anti-design-skill/docs/CLI-CONTRACT.md. Task-47 diffs the two.
name: anti-ai-design
description: Find the design habits that make an interface look AI-generated, then remove them or show how to improve them.

globalFlags.name: --help
globalFlags.description: Show help for the CLI or a command.

globalFlags.name: --json
globalFlags.description: Machine-readable result on stdout; human text goes to stderr.

globalFlags.name: --quiet
globalFlags.description: Print only the final count and exit code.

globalFlags.name: --cwd
globalFlags.description: Run as if started in this directory.

globalFlags.name: --no-inline-ignores
globalFlags.description: Do not honor inline disable comments.

exitCodes.0: Completed; no findings at or above the failing severity.
exitCodes.1: Runtime failure: a target could not be read or scanned.
exitCodes.2: Completed with findings at or above the failing severity, or unknown command or invalid usage.

findingShape.domain: type | color | layout | visual | motion | copy | imagery | quality | system
findingShape.fix: null | { tier: 'safe' | 'manual', patch: 'unified diff or null' }

commands.name: detect
commands.summary: Scan files, a folder or piped text for slop and quality findings.

args.name: target
args.description: File or folder. Reads stdin when omitted and input is piped.

flags.name: --fail-on
flags.description: Lowest severity that makes the exit code 2.

output.shape: { findings: Finding[], counts: { high, medium, low }, score: number, filesScanned: number }

commands.name: audit
commands.summary: Read-only implementation report: accessibility, theming, responsiveness, integrity, ordered by severity.

output.shape: { priorities: { P0, P1, P2, P3 }, areas: AreaScore[], findings: Finding[], total: number }

commands.name: critique
commands.summary: Read-only design review: what makes the page feel generic and what to fix first.

flags.name: --task
flags.description: The main thing a visitor must do; sharpens priorities.

output.shape: { strengths: string[], issues: Issue[], questions: string[], usability: { check, score|'n/a', reason }[], next: string[] }

commands.name: polish
commands.summary: Finish an existing page: apply safe fixes and list the rest.

flags.name: --write
flags.description: Apply safe fixes. Default is a dry run that prints a diff.

flags.name: --keep
flags.description: Property or token to leave alone, e.g. colors.

output.shape: { applied: Fix[], suggested: Finding[], diff: string }

commands.name: typeset
commands.summary: Fix typography: hierarchy, size, line height, measure, tracking, font defaults.

output.shape: { applied: Fix[], suggested: Finding[], diff: string }

commands.name: distill
commands.summary: Reduce clutter around the main task: duplicates, decoration, nested containers.

flags.name: --keep
flags.description: Selector or text that must remain.

output.shape: { removed: Fix[], suggested: Finding[], diff: string }

commands.name: generate
commands.summary: Produce alternative versions of one element and let the user compare and keep one.

args.name: element
args.description: Selector, file:line or a plain-language name.

flags.name: --direction
flags.description: bolder, quieter, simpler, typography, color, layout, motion.

flags.name: --accept
flags.description: Keep variant N and write it to source.

flags.name: --discard
flags.description: Discard the current set and restore the original.

output.shape: { sessionId: string, variants: { index, summary, diff }[], previewUrl: string|null }

commands.name: live
commands.summary: Local preview server for comparing variants in a running page.

flags.name: --stop
flags.description: Stop a running session and clean up.

commands.name: document
commands.summary: Record the project's existing visual system as DESIGN.md.

args.name: target
args.description: Folder to read. Defaults to the project.

flags.name: --seed
flags.description: Write a marked starting record for a project with no design yet.

flags.name: --write
flags.description: Write DESIGN.md. Default prints the proposal.

output.shape: { tokens: object, sections: string[], path: string|null }

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Create PRODUCT.md and the .anti-ai-design folder from what the project already tells us.

output.shape: { created: string[], inferred: object, open: string[] }
